hooks.command: node -e "const p=require('path');const r=(()=>{var e=process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT;if(e&&e.trim())return e.trim();var p=require('path'),f=require('fs'),q=p.join('scripts','lib','utils.js'),c=[];if(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR){var j=p.join(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR,'.claude');c.push(p.join(j,'_harness'),j)}var h=require('os').homedir(),d=p.join(h,'.claude');c.push(d,p.join(d,'_harness'),p.join(d,'plugins','_harness'));for(var l of c){if(f.existsSync(p.join(l,q)))return l}return d})();const s=p.join(r,'scripts/hooks/plugin-hook-bootstrap.js');process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=r;process.argv.splice(1,0,s);require(s)" node scripts/hooks/pre-bash-dispatcher.js

hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const {spawnSync}=require('child_process');const raw=fs.readFileSync(0,'utf8');const rel=path.join('scripts','hooks','subagent-budget.js');const has=c=>{const v=typeof c==='string'?c.trim():'';return v.length>0&&fs.existsSync(path.join(path.resolve(v),rel));};const root=(()=>{const e=process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT||'';if(has(e))return path.resolve(e.trim());const c=[];if(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR){const j=path.join(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR,'.claude');c.push(path.join(j,'_harness'),j);}const h=require('os').homedir();const d=path.join(h,'.claude');c.push(d,path.join(d,'_harness'),path.join(d,'plugins','_harness'));for(const x of c){if(has(x))return x;}return null;})();if(!root){process.stdout.write('{}');process.exit(0);}const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,[path.join(root,rel)],{input:raw,encoding:'utf8',env:process.env,cwd:process.cwd(),timeout:10000});process.stdout.write(typeof r.stdout==='string'&&r.stdout.trim()?r.stdout:'{}');process.exit(0);"
